Carlos Tevez is hoping to create a football spectacle by bringing Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo together on the same side for his testimonial match at La Bombonera on December 20. The former Argentina striker revealed his dream of seeing the two biggest names in modern football share the pitch at his farewell celebration, with their potential appearance already generating excitement among football fans. Speaking to Argentine broadcaster TyC Sports on Friday, Tevez expressed his excitement at the possibility of having both eight-time Ballon d’Or winner Messi and five-time recipient Ronaldo feature in the special occasion. Messi’s presence appears to be confirmed, but the prospect of Ronaldo joining him has raised eyebrows, given the rarity of seeing the two football icons playing together. Tevez, who finished 30th in the 2007 Ballon d’Or rankings, also joked about what could happen if the superstars came up against former Boca Juniors defender Rolando ‘Flaco’ Schiavi. He won’t even be able to see them!” Tevez said. They’re going to leave you flat on your back!'” The former Manchester United, Manchester City and Juventus forward clearly relishes the prospect of watching Messi and Ronaldo showcase their extraordinary abilities at La Bombonera. Although the two superstars have spent much of their careers as rivals, their potential reunion on the same team would offer a rare opportunity for fans to see them combine rather than compete against each other. Messi and Ronaldo dominated world football for more than a decade, winning 13 Ballon d’Or awards between them and setting remarkable records at club and international level. For Tevez, having the pair feature at his testimonial would make an already special occasion even more memorable. Whether Ronaldo accepts the invitation remains to be seen, but the prospect of Messi and CR7 wearing the same colours at La Bombonera is certainly a dream worth waiting for.
